page.overview:
What is Harvester?

The Harvester was a mammalian tunneling creature native to the Outer Rim Territories world Tartarus. The Harvester could be wrangled and used in mining operations. In 2108, pioneer J.V. Gorham planned to import Harvesters to the Far Spinward Colonies planet KOI-2650.01 to increase productivity at Gorham's Colony. A population of Harvesters was also present on the FSC planet Aljanna.
